Value is given in microseconds. Parameters (inout) None Parameters (out) None Return value Std_ReturnType E_OK: Function successful E_NOT_OK: Development error occurred Description Sets the value of "NTU adjust". Together with the local oscillator period, "TUR adjust" can be derived from "NTU adjust". Available via TtcanIf.h
